display_name: Dependency reachability engine table (one row per SCA match)
validation_rules: engine-reachability.json must satisfy engine-reachability.schema.json; one row per accepted SCA match

advisory symbols come only from the hash-bound reviewed map or the OSV index judged at the SCA completion time, and are resolved through the vendored dependency's own manifest (dep_symbol_resolver); every step is recorded in the row

reachable requires a witness whose every hop is hash-bound to the run's source projection; unreachable only from the ir engine with the vulnerable function's source analysed and a hash-bound target; the codeql engine never reports unreachable
CodeQL databases are the ones the 02-codeql-<lang> nodes retained, re-hashed before use and mounted read-only; nothing is rebuilt; queries run only in the pinned audit-codeql image with network none
symbols reach CodeQL only as data-extension rows; no advisory or model text is spliced into QL
an absent, stale or unverifiable engine input is a coverage gap, never a block; unknown is never 'not vulnerable'
the table is re-derived from the receipts and bound inputs on every validate
rows are evidence leads, not findings
